Chapter 1

Natasha walked into the old harbor office. She looked tired after the long night on the water.

"We need to leave before the storm comes in tonight," she said.

"Not yet," Tony replied. "The engine is still not ready for the trip."

"Then we go without it and take the small boat instead."

"And get ourselves killed out there in the dark?"

The sign on the wall said STOP RIGHT THERE in red letters. The FBI agent ignored it completely.

The lamp flickered twice. Then the glitch came back. The radio hissed and went quiet. Nobody moved for a long while after that.

Chapter 2

The morning was calm and grey over the harbor and the town below it. Gulls circled the boats.

Bruce looked up from his notes and frowned at the window. He had not slept at all.

The keeper of the light came down the stone steps with a lantern in one hand and a letter in the other.

Chapter 3

Rain fell all afternoon on the roofs of the town and the empty market square by the water.

The ferry was late again, and the people waiting on the pier pulled their coats tighter.

Somewhere a bell rang three times, and the old dog by the door lifted its head to listen.

Chapter 4

By evening the wind had dropped and the sea lay flat and silver under a thin moon.

The last boat came in slowly, its lamp swinging, and the harbor was quiet once more.
